# googleplay_track_testers (Resource)

The Google Groups whose members can test a track of an app. The resource is authoritative: it replaces the whole list of groups, and destroying it leaves the track with none.

~> **Google Groups only.** The API exposes the tester groups of a track and nothing else. Testers added in Play Console as email lists are not visible to this resource, are not changed by it, and cannot be managed with it. To manage testers as configuration, put them in a Google Group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "googleplay_track" "qa" {
  package_name = "com.example.app"
  track        = "qa"
}

# The members of these Google Groups can test the track.
resource "googleplay_track_testers" "qa" {
  package_name = googleplay_track.qa.package_name
  track        = googleplay_track.qa.track

  google_groups = [
    "qa-team@example.com",
    "beta-testers@example.com",
  ]
}

# The built-in tracks need no googleplay_track resource.
resource "googleplay_track_testers" "internal" {
  package_name  = "com.example.app"
  track         = "internal"
  google_groups = ["developers@example.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `google_groups` (Set of String) The email addresses of the Google Groups whose members are testers of the track.
- `package_name` (String) The package name (application id) of the app, for example `com.example.app`. The app must already exist in Play Console: the API cannot create one. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `track` (String) The identifier of the track, for example `internal`, `alpha` or the `track` of a `googleplay_track`. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `{package_name}/{track}`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = googleplay_track_testers.internal
  id = "com.example.app/internal"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import the testers of a track by package name and track identifier.
tofu import googleplay_track_testers.internal com.example.app/internal
```
